\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 192-195 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:GE-R200-first-pass-words-from-chapters-192-195}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a waitress and cutlery.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a departure, an arrival, a take-off, a delay, a platform
  \item a timetable, a return journey, accommodation, a youth hostel, luggage
  \item a rucksack, a sight, a city map, a round trip, a market square
  \item a pedestrian zone, a cathedral, a monument, a tower, a castle
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A departure? (\textbf{die Abfahrt}.) An arrival? (\textbf{die Ankunft}.) A take-off? (\textbf{der Abflug}.) A delay? (\textbf{die Verspätung}.) A platform? (\textbf{das Gleis}.) A timetable? (\textbf{der Fahrplan}.) A return journey? (\textbf{die Rückfahrt}.) Accommodation? (\textbf{die Unterkunft}.) A youth hostel? (\textbf{die Jugendherberge}.) Luggage? (\textbf{das Gepäck}.) A rucksack? (\textbf{der Rucksack}.) A sight? (\textbf{die Sehenswürdigkeit}.) A city map? (\textbf{der Stadtplan}.) A round trip? (\textbf{die Rundfahrt}.) A market square? (\textbf{der Marktplatz}.) A pedestrian zone? (\textbf{die Fußgängerzone}.) A cathedral? (\textbf{der Dom}.) A monument? (\textbf{das Denkmal}.) A tower? (\textbf{der Turm}.) A castle? (\textbf{die Burg}.)
\end{tcolorbox}

  \item a coast, fog, heat, cold, lightning

  \item a menu, an order, a tip, a waitress, cutlery

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A harbour? (\textbf{der Hafen}.) A bank? (\textbf{das Ufer}.) A beach? (\textbf{der Strand}.) A meadow? (\textbf{die Wiese}.) A valley? (\textbf{das Tal}.) A coast? (\textbf{die Küste}.) Fog? (\textbf{der Nebel}.) Heat? (\textbf{die Hitze}.) Cold? (\textbf{die Kälte}.) Lightning? (\textbf{der Blitz}.) An animal? (\textbf{das Tier}.) A hare? (\textbf{der Hase}.) A fly? (\textbf{die Fliege}.) A butterfly? (\textbf{der Schmetterling}.) A plant? (\textbf{die Pflanze}.) Grass? (\textbf{das Gras}.) A fruit? (\textbf{die Frucht}.) A carrot? (\textbf{die Karotte}.) A chicken? (\textbf{das Hähnchen}.) A gateau? (\textbf{die Torte}.) A menu? (\textbf{die Speisekarte}.) An order? (\textbf{die Bestellung}.) A tip? (\textbf{das Trinkgeld}.) A waitress? (\textbf{die Kellnerin}.) Cutlery? (\textbf{das Besteck}.)
